trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for REAL_ESTATE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- booking_amount: Handle token and booking amounts, allotment status and refund requests within RERA rules.
- site_visit_scheduling: Qualify a lead against real inventory and book a site visit with a named executive.

Business context:
- booking_amount: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.
- site_visit_scheduling: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [booking_amount]
  - Deduction truth: The deduction and refundable amount must be the ones the eligibility tool returns.
  - Eligibility first: No refund may be initiated before check_refund_eligibility has returned eligible.
  - No timeline promises: The processing time quoted must be the tool's, never an assurance of sooner.
  - Confirmed allotment: A confirmed allotment follows the agreement's cancellation terms, not the token policy.
  [site_visit_scheduling]
  - Price truth: Only a price returned by check_inventory may be quoted. No 'starting from' figure the tool did not return.
  - Possession claims: Possession may only be stated as the quarter the inventory record carries, never as a promise.
  - RERA disclosure: The RERA id must be stated when a project is discussed, when the tool returns one.
  - No investment advice: The agent must not advise whether a property is a good investment or predict appreciation.

Tools available to you (7): check_inventory, check_refund_eligibility, initiate_refund, lookup_booking, lookup_lead, schedule_site_visit, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: ta-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inventory
model_visible_tools.description: List unsold units in a project with carpet area, floor, price and possession quarter.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the cancellation policy to a booking and return what is refundable.

model_visible_tools.name: initiate_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Start a refund against a cancelled booking.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_booking
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a booking's unit, amounts paid, allotment state and cancellation window.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_lead
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a lead's stated budget, preferred configuration and prior visits.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_site_visit
model_visible_tools.description: Book a site visit slot with an assigned sales executive.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Misreads domain terminology and asks for it in plain words.
Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.
Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative.
Repeats what the agent said to check they understood.

steps.purpose: Introduces the purpose of the outbound call.
steps.text: வணக்கம், நான் developer sales desk-ல இருந்து பேசுறேன். நாளைக்கு நீங்க site visit schedule பண்ணிருக்கீங்க, அத confirm பண்ண கால் பண்ணேன்.

steps.purpose: Expresses confusion about the terminology and asks for clarification.
steps.text: ஆமா, ஆனா அதுக்கு முன்னாடி எனக்கு ஒரு சந்தேகம். 'sight visit' னா என்ன? நான் நேர்ல வந்து பாக்கணுமா?
steps.clean_text: ஆமா, ஆனா அதுக்கு முன்னாடி எனக்கு ஒரு சந்தேகம். 'site visit' னா என்ன? நான் நேர்ல வந்து பாக்கணுமா?
steps.model_visible_text: ஆமா, ஆனா அதுக்கு முன்னாடி எனக்கு ஒரு சந்தேகம். 'sight visit' னா என்ன? நான் நேர்ல வந்து பாக்கணுமா?

steps.purpose: Clarifies the term and asks for identity verification factors.
steps.text: ஆமாங்க, நீங்க நேர்ல வந்து project-அ பாக்குறது தான் site visit. நீங்க வரதுக்கு முன்னாடி உங்க identity-அ verify பண்ணனும். உங்க registered name இல்லனா date of birth சொல்ல முடியுமா?

steps.purpose: Repeats the explanation to confirm understanding and provides verification details.
steps.text: நேர்ல வந்து project-அ பாக்குறது தான் site visit-ஆ? சரி. என் registered name குமார், date of birth 15th May 1980.

steps.purpose: Verifies the customer's identity using the provided factors.
Returns the result of the identity verification.
Acknowledges successful verification and asks to confirm the visit.
steps.text: நன்றி குமார். உங்க identity verify ஆயிடுச்சு. நாளைக்கு visit confirm பண்ணிக்கலாமா?

steps.purpose: Agrees to confirm but asks for investment advice.
steps.text: visit confirm பண்ணிக்கலாம். ஆனா இந்த property investment-க்கு நல்லா இருக்குமா? விலை ஏறுமா னு சொல்லுங்க.

steps.purpose: Declines to give investment advice and refers to a professional.
steps.text: மன்னிக்கவும், investment advice குடுக்குறது என் வேலை இல்ல. விலை ஏறுமா னு நான் கணிக்க முடியாது. நீங்க ஒரு financial advisor கிட்ட தான் அத பத்தி கேக்கணும். நான் inventory details மட்டும் சொல்ல முடியும்.

steps.purpose: Accepts the limitation, repeats the instruction, and asks for price and possession details.
steps.text: Financial advisor கிட்ட கேக்கணுமா? சரி. அப்புறம், என்ன விலை, possession எப்போ னு சொல்லுங்க. Project பேரு 'Green Valley'.

steps.purpose: Looks up the lead to get the preferred configuration.
Returns the lead details including configuration.
Checks inventory for the project and configuration.
Provides the requested inventory details based on the tool result.
steps.text: Green Valley project-ல 3BHK available இருக்கு. இதோட RERA ID PRM/KA/RERA/1251/446/PR/123456. விலை 11000000. Possession Q4 2025-ல கிடைக்கும். நாளைக்கு visit confirm பண்ணலாமா?

steps.purpose: Repeats the details and confirms the visit for the morning.
steps.text: விலை 11000000, possession Q4 2025-ஆ? சரி, நாளைக்கு morning visit confirm பண்ணுங்க.

steps.purpose: Informs the user of the successful booking and concludes the task.
steps.text: உங்க visit confirm ஆயிடுச்சு. Visit reference VR-9988. நாளைக்கு morning Ramesh உங்கள நேர்ல meet பண்ணுவாரு.

verification.summary: The conversation is an excellent synthetic training example. The agent correctly handles an outbound call scenario, using the implicit lead ID to verify the customer and fetch their details. The tool dependency chain (lookup_lead to get the configuration -> check_inventory) is perfectly executed. The agent successfully enforces persona boundaries by declining to give investment advice and accurately grounds its response in the tool output, adhering to all business rules including RERA disclosure. The persona traits (repeating instructions, misreading domain terms) are naturally integrated, and the language perfectly balances native Tamil script with Roman English domain terms.
